title: Blog · dynamic index
description: SEO-oriented blog index with CMS-authored H1/H2/H3 introduction and backend-driven article cards from the public Core CMS blog endpoint.

source.adapted_from: Existing public blog-post list endpoint and metadata contract.
source.decision: Posts are never authored as static slots; the browser runtime loads them from Core CMS while the index introduction remains server-rendered.

params.name: Blog · API Base
params.description: Core CMS base path used for the public blog-post endpoint.

params.name: Blog · Organization
params.description: Organization code used in the public Core CMS request.

params.name: Blog · Category ID
params.description: Optional backend blog category ID. Leave empty to show every category.

params.name: Blog · Visible Page Size
params.description: Number of cards revealed per page after the featured article.

params.name: Blog · Maximum Results
params.description: Safety limit for articles loaded from Core CMS.

params.name: Blog · Index Path
params.description: Public localized route used by the blog index.

params.name: Blog · Post Path
params.description: Public localized route prefix used when building article links.

params.name: Blog · Fixture URL
params.description: Local preview-only JSON URL. Keep empty in CMS production.
